claims.text: The unsigned MYR draft does not establish that every claim of MYR availability comes only from that draft. The draft itself says MYR settlement is available but characterizes it as a proposal, not an approved operating rule, so its scope is confined to a proposed state and does not address the origin of other MYR availability claims.
